notes: 3,000 basic everyday English words/expressions with practical Asante Twi equivalents.

Twi is context-sensitive. Some English words have multiple Twi equivalents, and some entries are common learning expressions built from core vocabulary. For formal publishing or teaching, have a fluent Twi speaker review the list.
The workbook preserves Twi letters such as ɛ, ɔ, Ɛ and Ɔ.
